# moodle-cli 0.5.3

## Summary

This patch finishes the npm Trusted Publishing workflow fix.

## Fixes

- Run npm publish with `npm@latest` in GitHub Actions so the runner uses trusted publishing instead of falling back to legacy login state.
- Keep the package-content guard that verifies `dist/moodle.js` is present before publish.

## Validation

Validated with:

- `npm run check`
- `npm test`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run pack:check`
